At No Dough Bakery we prioritize delivering fresh and top-quality products to our customers but if there was an issue with your order, we will do our utmost to make it right. 

Since our products  are perishable & made to order, we do not offer refunds or accept returns. However, we understand that situations may arise where a refund or return is necessary. Please read our policy below for more information:
